newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen A index ends lower, no B share trading.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen A index ends lower, no B share trading.

text.p: Shenzhen's domestic currency A share index closed lower Monday on steady losses after a string of disappointing first half company results, analysts said.
Trading in the hard currency B share market was suspended for one day in line with a public holiday in Hong Kong.
The A share index tumbled 9.73 points, or 2.59 percent, to 365.47 on turnover of 3.3 billion yuan compared with Friday's 3.4 billion.
